verdict.rationale: Dagster's docs describe pipeline/asset definitions as Python code and note it can be self-hosted via Docker, which gestures at openness, but there is no evidence of an explicit data export feature or open-format export/portability guarantee for underlying data — Dagster orchestrates external systems rather than storing/exporting data itself. missing for 10: any documentation of exporting pipeline metadata, run history, or data in open formats, and any explicit no-lock-in/data-portability statement.
